library.heading: Workflows
library.importFailed: That file is not a workflow export.
library.storageFull: Browser storage is full, so this workflow could not be saved. Delete old workflows or export them.

text-image-video.name: Text → Image → Video
text-image-video.description: Generate a still from a prompt, then animate it with a second prompt.

upscale-remove-bg.name: Image → Upscale → Remove background
upscale-remove-bg.description: Upload an image, upscale it and cut out the subject.

talking-portrait.name: Prompt → Image → Lip sync
talking-portrait.description: Create a portrait, voice a script with text-to-speech and make the portrait say it. Swap the voice node for an Audio input to use your own recording.

edit-chain.name: Image edit chain
edit-chain.description: Two edits in a row: change the scene, then restyle it with a prompt combiner.

toolbar.describeSetup: Add an OpenRouter, OpenAI or Gemini key in Settings → Providers to draft workflows from a sentence.

node.pasteUrl: Or paste a URL and press Enter
node.waiting: Connect a node and run the workflow to see the result here.

inspector.label: Name
inspector.promptConnected: A connected text node provides the prompt. Disconnect it to type one here.
inspector.noParameters: This model has no extra parameters.
inspector.runNodeHint: Runs this node and anything upstream that has no result yet.
inspector.emptyBody: Add nodes from the toolbar or start from a template. Drag from a node's right handle to a matching input on another node. Colors show what flows: violet text, cyan images, pink video, amber audio.

describe.title: Describe a workflow
describe.body: Say what the pipeline should do. Your chat model drafts the nodes; the draft opens as a new workflow you can edit.
describe.placeholder: e.g. Turn my text into a product photo, remove the background, then animate it into a short video
describe.empty: The assistant did not return any usable nodes. Try describing the steps more concretely.

run.cycle: This workflow has a loop. Remove one of the connections in the loop and try again.
run.failed: {count} node(s) failed. Check the red nodes for details.
run.cancelled: Run cancelled. Jobs already sent to a provider may still finish (and bill) there.
run.alreadyRunning: A run is already in progress.

errors.missingMedia: Add a file or URL first.
errors.nothingConnected: Nothing is connected to this output.
errors.modelMissing: Choose a model for this node.
errors.unsupportedFile: Drop images, videos or audio files.
